steps.name: run-stage14e-projected-residual-smoothing-audit-fixed
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=34d164cd7b5a68ed7b46228e7aef8539c7539c6e; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage14/stage14d_residual_intervention_audit.py > /tmp/stage14d-residual-intervention-audit.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage14/stage14e_projected_residual_smoothing_audit.py > /tmp/stage14e-projected-residual-smoothing-audit.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/stage14e-projected-residual-smoothing-audit.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('import math\n', 'import math\nimport sys\n', 1)
needle = "base = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\nspec.loader.exec_module(base)"
replacement = "base = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\nsys.modules[spec.name] = base\nspec.loader.exec_module(base)"
if needle not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected Stage 14E import block not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(needle, replacement, 1))
PY
.venv/bin/python -m py_compile /tmp/stage14d-residual-intervention-audit.py /tmp/stage14e-projected-residual-smoothing-audit.py; PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python /tmp/stage14e-projected-residual-smoothing-audit.py; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
